name: Akashic Mechanisms (Akashic, Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Android or forgeborn.

Benefit(s): You may invest essence into your nanite surge racial trait to gain an additional use per day for each point invested or invest essence into your fearless, strange mind, natural armor, crystal skin, memory matrix, or constructed racial traits (individually) to increase any of their bonuses by 1 for each point invested.

You gain one point of essence.
